synthesis.procedure: Under an inert atmosphere (glovebox/Schlenk/vacuum-line techniques), [Yb(DippForm)2(thf)2] (0.1 g, 0.1 mmol) and 9-fluorenone (fn; 0.02 g, 0.1 mmol) were stirred in THF to give a deep maroon solution of [Yb(DippForm)2(fn·-O)(thf)]. [SmI2(thf)2] (~0.06 g, ~0.1 mmol) was added, immediately darkening the mixture. After stirring at room temperature, the mixture was concentrated in vacuo and toluene was added, immediately precipitating a highly air-sensitive dark maroon material. Microscopic examination showed dark maroon crystals of [Sm10O4({C13H8}-O)10(thf)10]·THF·solv (1), together with smaller crystals and powder of uniform colour. Synchrotron X-ray analysis identified 1. Drying under vacuum to remove lattice solvent gave an amorphous dark powder; elemental analysis of the dried material indicated decomposition. All solvents were sodium-dried, distilled, and freeze–pump–thaw degassed.
